equations.joint: L0=1m; c_m=original RAW center; v_m=max_k |c_k-c_m| over available original RAW/B3/B5 centers; h_m=(z_m-a_m)/2+v_m+rho_m/2; N_m=max(original RMS descriptor,original filter descriptor); d_m=(D_L+D_R)/(40m); T_ms=max(0,1-|u_s-c_m|/h_m); V_ms=1 iff u_s is inside the original own shoulder and existing scalar interpolation is available; e_ms=max(0,I_s-b_m-lambda*N_m) when V_ms=1 else 0; E_m=sum_s e_ms*Delta_s/L0; Z_m=sum_s V_ms*T_ms*Delta_s; f_ms=V_ms*T_ms/Z_m iff Z_m>0 and E_m>0; H_m=G*(1+B*d_m)*E_m iff Z_m>0 else 0; A_ms=H_m*f_ms iff H_m>0 else 0; R=1-sum_c q_c; D=1+sum_m H_m; q_0=R/D; q_m=R*H_m/D; p_s=q_0*U_s+sum_m q_m*f_ms+sum_c q_c*f_cs; U_s=1/sum_s Delta_s
equations.weakLimit: For fixed finite receipts and masks, uniformly vanishing e makes E, H and q_m tend to zero; the measured contribution disappears continuously. With all measured fields zero, the remainder is exactly R*U plus unchanged censored contributions. Availability and receipt changes are separate discontinuities.
equations.zeroSupport: Missing required original receipts or pitch support, and grouped-parent exclusion, retain their explicit unavailable outcome and zero measured mass before eligible finite-receipt checks. Then zero available own-shoulder cells gives UNAVAILABLE_ADMITTED_SHOULDER_SUPPORT; next Z=0 gives NO_ADMITTED_TENT_SUPPORT; next E=0 gives OBSERVED_ZERO_EXCESS. Each has H=q_m=0 and no normalized measured row. Invalid interpolation or outside own shoulder has V=0. Positive E with Z=0 remains NO_ADMITTED_TENT_SUPPORT; never evaluate 0*undefined.
equations.uniform: U=1/sum(all admitted cell widths), including invalid cells; configured full plus/minus25m domain and V3 state admission unchanged
equations.censored: Original effective q_c and original normalized f_c from the one shared baseline producer, exactly unchanged; no posterior reconstruction
equations.anchors: Conditioned exact anchors have unary=0 and log integration measure=0; no observation grants movement/Apply/endpoint/cleanup authority
equations.L0: L0=1 metre; unary=-log(L0*p), existing log floor1e-300 only; FB cell measure=width/L0; negative unary valid
equations.score: Unique curve/profile intersection categorical proper log score -log(p_target*cellWidth); physical chainage weighting, equal scene then geometry/source group then contrast family. Ambiguous labels diagnostic only, no invented probabilities.
equations.selection: Accumulate proper scores for all32 configurations in original TRAIN catalog order. Apply cheap controls, then complete TRAIN geometry in score/G/lambda/B configuration order and selector-first/pitch-descending/variant/contrast/side scene order; a configuration is FEASIBLE only when all original TRAIN cases and required applicable controls finish. Rank only FEASIBLE finite-score configurations; evaluate at most four fully feasible configurations on fresh SELECT after the family, source, catalog and manifest are frozen and the fully feasible shortlist is fixed. Lower geometry after the four-feasible cutoff remains UNTESTED. Any encountered error aborts the entire run with no candidate and no clock reset. Preserve the unchanged baseline comparison within 1e-12; freeze one candidate, run unchanged regressions, then sealed HOLDOUT once. No regression or HOLDOUT reselection.
equations.acceptance: Existing physical shape bounds unchanged; matched resampling per-mode mass delta<=0.02, center displacement<=factual source pitch or explicitly sampling-only descriptor, conditional IQR shrink<=10%; missing correspondence fails. Actual production raw+final geometry and unchanged safety required.
equations.bounds: 32configs,512scenes,4096profiles/scene,8M extraction and8M mode-cell work/scene/config,60min FIT_SELECT; <=64MiB live scene+scratch within unchanged attempt ledger; <=2GiB disk cache; no holdout before artifact validation

capabilities.native: rho=factual native ground pitch; tagged original RAW plus at least one filtered center and original high-core endpoints required; correlated stage receipts share one physical source lineage
capabilities.unknownNative: rho=max actual adjacent physical sample gap in own shoulder; sampling descriptor only, never native uncertainty/independent information; separate empirical phase/resampling gates
capabilities.groupedParent: No original elementary receipt means unavailable measured field; no fabricated background/stage centers. Record missing capability and fail any required comparison, never hidden baseline substitution.
